additional_info.body:
Hello,
Enclosed you will find new information from our customer regarding charging interruptions on the MB eActros truck.
I hope this information will help you with your further analysis.
„Our authorized workshop also investigated this issue together with Daimler Trucks. Daimler recommended installing the ECOG 1.4.11 patch on our charging stations. According to them, there are communication errors coming from our charging stations.
After yesterday's update, we noticed that the maximum power for two eActros trucks was limited to 280 kW this time (instead of 300 kW), while another truck was still charging at 300 kW. However, charging interruptions are still occurring. One truck only charged to 48% overnight.“
Best regards,
Ralph Lindner
